name: svg-french-press-gpt-6-luna-s3-r1
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="1100" viewBox="0 0 1200 1100">
 <defs>

  <filter id="shadow" x="-.2" y="-.3" width="1.4" height="1.7"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="5"/></filter>
  <style>
   .label{font:600 17px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#20333a;letter-spacing:.25px}.small{font:13px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#53666c}.num{font:700 14px 'Arial',sans-serif;fill:#fff}.leader{fill:none;stroke:#73878c;stroke-width:1.5}.metal{stroke:#52666d;stroke-width:1.6}.fine{fill:none;stroke:#9bb0b5;stroke-width:1.5}
  </style>
